messages.subject: min.per.group for multiple groups (more than 2)
parts:
Dear all,

This question is similar with below one (treating min.per.groups for multiple groups), but i want to do it with 3 groups. 
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/methylkit_discussion/0-G5QvXGQc4/lVlQ4D7TAQAJ;context-place=searchin/methylkit_discussion/min.per.group$20groups%7Csort:date

say I have 12 samples for each treatment (0,1 and 2) and united then with (min.group.for=c(6L,6L,6L) ). 
But some of loci with more than 6 samples for each group were lost.

Did i used min.group.for in wrong way?
(my methylKit version is 1.2.4)

Regard,
-Youngjune-

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] min.per.group for multiple groups (more than 2)
parts:
why don't you use min.per.group=6L, this should give you loci that is covered in at least 6 samples in each group ? if you are using it and don't get expected results please send a reproducible example. 

Best,
Altuna
